metrics.definition: Named participants completing live agentic transactions.
Organizations named in the AP4M launch release.

costs.caveat: Secondary review by Nevermined, an AP4M participant.

costs.item: Agent-specific interchange, token fee, liability rule or reason code
costs.value: None public; the Mastercard Agent Pay Program Standards that the Mastercard Rules (2026-06-02) require are not public
costs.whoPays: Not stated; no agent fee found
costs.caveat: No agentic interchange category or token fee was found. A May 2026 merchant-cost note expects new fee categories but names none. Mastercard says standard chargeback rights apply; Worldpay (2026-07-30) says no liability shift exists yet.

costs.value: Tokens accepted through existing processors; PCI scope unchanged
costs.whoPays: Merchant pays its existing acquirer fees
costs.caveat: Mastercard describes no extra merchant fee; that is an absence of a statement, not a statement of zero fees.

costs.value: Sellers on Stripe support agentic network tokens automatically; no Agent Pay-specific Stripe price stated
costs.whoPays: Not stated; Stripe prices SPTs per SPT issued
costs.caveat: Stripe's US pricing page lists Shared Payment Tokens at 0.15 USD per SPT issued, listed since at least 2026-04-23; it does not name the party billed or say how the price applies to Agent Pay tokens.
Neither the 2026-06-10 announcement nor the 2026-10-20 Early Access brief gives pricing; the Early Access documentation is not public. Settlement costs per rail not published.
